system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: sys_prompt="You are an expert programming assistant: {name}."
system_prompt_style.note: Supervisor prompt also has variable {{language}}: 'analyze vulnerabilities in {{language}} code'.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: VulnSage consumes structured vulnerability candidate reports in a standardized JSON format.
env_context_strategy.note: Repository knowledge is injected via static-analysis reports (call chains, code slices); agents also have execute/install/findSanitizer tools. No enum fits cleanly; coded mixed as closest.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: it splits the large alert information into several shorter prompts, preventing each from ex-
context_compaction.note: Constraints accumulated/summarized incrementally to stay under token limit; no per-observation truncation observed in evidence.

observation_format.note: Execution traces, error messages and JSON alert info are plain text; a browser service exists in agentscope but is not used by default.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Respond with specific tags as outlined below:
<observation>{what you observe}</observation>
<thought>{what you thought}</thought>
<action>{the action name you want to call}</action>

tool_count.evidence_quote:
service_toolkit.add(installJavaPackage)
        service_toolkit.add(initJavaEnvironment)
        service_toolkit.add(executeJavaCode)
        service_toolkit.add(generateJavaCode)
        service_toolkit.add(reflectSelfCritics)
        service_toolkit.add(findSanitizer)
        service_toolkit.add(final_output)
tool_count.note: JavaAgent registers 7 services; JS agent registers 7 similar tools. Supervisor exposes sub-agents as ~6 actions.

edit_primitive.note: No repo file-editing tool; agent generates complete exploit scripts. Closest is whole_file_rewrite.

tool_schema_source.note: AgentScope ServiceToolkit derives function schemas from function signatures/docstrings.

protocol_standardization.note: Only AgentScope ServiceToolkit and internal gRPC RPC; no MCP/A2A protocol in source.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The Validation Agent and Reflec-
tion Agents form a feedback-driven self-refinement loop that uses
execution traces and runtime error analysis to either improve the
exploit iteratively
loop_primitives.note: Supervisor follows ReAct; validation+reflection is generate-test-repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
we do not explicitly enforce the super-
visor agent to follow a fixed order of taking actions
planning_granularity.note: Planning is via ReAct reasoning; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
decomposing the complex AEG process
into multiple specialized sub-agents: Code Analyzer Agent, Code
Generation Agent, Validation Agent, and a set of Reflection Agents,
orchestrated by a central supervisor through iterative cycles.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: invokes sub-agents to discover exploitable vulnerabilities
delegation_mechanism.note: Supervisor invokes specialized sub-agents as actions.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Run a single analysis task for either TypeScript/JavaScript or Java projects.
human_in_loop.note: CLI runs fully automated; no approval/confirmation gate found.

short_term_state.note: Message-list memory; accumulated constraints passed through prompts, not a typed state object.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: In-memory memory module, not writing to hard disk

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Session id used to isolate runs/environments on the backend. Usually no need to change.
state_persistence.note: TemporaryMemory is in-memory; no resume/checkpoint path.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
The Validation Agent checks whether the exploit succeeds by exe-
cuting the code in a sandbox. If it fails, it provides runtime feedback
self_verification.note: Reflection agents (reflectSelfCritics) provide self-critique; validation runs exploit code.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
For each alert, VulnSage is allowed at most 20 attempts to
generate a valid result.
retry_policy.note: Retries via reflection until exploit validates or FP concluded, capped at 20 attempts.

rollback.note: No undo/revert/git-reset tool in the registered services or evidence.

termination_condition.note: max_iters caps steps; Finish action is model_declared ('6. Finish: Finish reasoning'); 20-attempt cap per alert.

cost_controls.note: Model selectable via config but no cost cap/routing/caching control found.

timeouts.note: Only distributed-mode rpc max_timeout_seconds (off by default); no per-tool/per-run execution timeout surfaced in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: We assume you have Docker and Docker Compose installed.
execution_isolation.note: Exploits executed in the Go server validation environment container; frontend also containerized.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
The Validation Agent checks whether the exploit succeeds by exe-
cuting the code in a sandbox.
filesystem_access.note: Full access within the validation sandbox container.

network_policy.note: JNDI exploits perform network lookups; no egress restriction configured.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
the Validation Agent performs
an analysis and rejects it if it contains direct command-execution
API calls (like Runtime.exec, child\_process.exec)
permission_model.note: Anti-cheat blocklist of banned APIs; coded static_allowlist per manual.

tracing.note: AgentScope studio dashboard also present in repo but not on by default.

replayability.note: No replay facility found in evidence.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Run a single analysis task for either TypeScript/JavaScript or Java projects.
eval_hooks.note: CLI runs single task; benchmark evaluation (SecBench.js) described only in paper, no runner shipped in evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
the validation
pipeline applies both static and dynamic anti-cheat checks.
guardrails.note: Anti-cheat static/dynamic checks reject invalid exploits before acceptance.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Exploit Generation with Constraint-Guided Comprehension and Reflection
target_domain.note: Security/exploit generation over code repositories (Java/JavaScript packages).

open_source.evidence_quote: The internal white-box analysis engine is not open-sourced due to licensing restrictions.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
we also evaluate the performance of GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V31, and
Qwen3-Plus
model_agnostic.note: AgentScope provides multiple model wrappers incl. litellm/openai/anthropic; model selectable in config.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote:
We open-sourced our implementation anonymously in https:
//github.com/Vulnsage/VulnSage.

first_release_date.note: Basis: pinned commit date; paper v1 dated 2026-04-06.
